messages.subject: matrix column as lvalue?
parts:
I'm sorry if this is covered in the manual. I looked, but may have missed the appropriate place.

In a stan model block, is there a way to assign a vector to a column of a matrix, or must I write a loop to assign each element?

I want to do the equivalent of the R expression

m[,j] <- v

I tried assigning to col(m,j), but col() does not return an lvalue, so that won't work.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] matrix column as lvalue?
parts:
Thanks for searching the manual, but there's no way
to do that built in yet.

I added a note to our manual issue to clarify the
legal lvalues in a table.

At some point, we'll extend the matrix indexing and
assignment operations to make the R assignment you
want to do legal (either with the syntax as written
or using col() and block() operations --- but I'd
rather do it in full generality). There's nothing
fundamentally difficult about doing this --- it's just
a matter of getting the coding time to do it.

If it's any help, you can assign rows using syntax

m[j] <- rv;

where m is a matrix and rv is a row vector.

We'll also be adding the R equivalent of rbind and
cbind if that's what you really want. But not for 2.4.

- Bob
